task: FV2-021 — Flutter Design V2 responsive message attachment cards
summary: Matched Flutter message attachment cards to the current web geometry while preserving authenticated preview/download and upload behavior. No web, API, ACL, storage or conversation state code changed.

checks.name: Test-first attachment geometry and state regressions
checks.observation: The new desktop image-card regression first failed because Flutter had no matching 440 px card; after implementation, desktop 440×238 / 438×200 preview, compact 390×182 / 388×144 preview, and 340×62 generic file-card bounds all pass. Existing protected-preview, loading, retry, unavailable, semantics and focus tests remain green.

checks.name: Android release APK
checks.artifact: 1.0.29+2053, 115.5 MB at clients/flutter/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk; ignored local build output, not added to Git.

checks.name: Android API 35 runtime visual acceptance
checks.command: adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk; launch ru.boohtacord.app; inspect Text channel attachment
checks.observation: Installed build 2053 in place over build 2052 without deleting app data. The existing Text channel showed the full-size image preview at compact 144 px height and its filename, size and download footer. The image request resolved after the first placeholder frame. No message was sent.

checks.name: macOS runtime visual acceptance
checks.command: User-authorized restart of the running Mac client into the freshly built Debug app; inspect the existing Text attachment
checks.observation: The persisted session restored without a Keychain prompt. The Mac screenshot showed the protected image at 200 px preview height with filename, size and download footer; the workspace remained in Text. No message was sent.
